description: Source code for prometheus metrics value handling, including definitions for ValueType enum, valueFunc struct, and functions for creating and populating metrics with fixed values, timestamps, and labels.

classes.name: valueFunc
classes.description: A generic metric for simple values retrieved on collect time, implementing Metric and Collector.

classes.name: constMetric
classes.description: A metric with a fixed value that cannot be changed, used for custom metrics.

methods.description: Populates a dto.Metric with a value based on the metric type and other parameters.

methods.description: Creates protobuf LabelPairs from variable and constant labels in a Desc.

methods.name: newExemplar
methods.description: Creates a new dto.Exemplar from provided values, validating label names and total rune count.
